title: School-Morning Departure On-Time Rate
dataSources: Baby feedings (`baby:feed`), baby sleep (`baby:sleep`), diaper changes (`diaper:change`), school departures (`school:departure`), stroller activity (`stroller:walk`), household chores (`chore:event`), and family geofence events (`family:location`).
app: Family and baby telemetry from baby-tracking apps, school and geofence automations, stroller logs, chore trackers, and shared-home events streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and Home Assistant.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=school:departure
| stats sum(eval(if(on_time=1,1,0))) as on_time_days count as school_days by child
| eval on_time_pct=round(100*on_time_days/school_days,1)
description: Calculates how often each child left for school on time across the tracked period.
value: Morning punctuality is one of those family routines that improves only when it becomes visible and measurable.
implementation: Capture school departure events with an on-time flag derived from a target departure window.
visualization: Bar chart of on-time departure percentage by child.
grandmaExplanation: It logs how often school mornings start on time instead of turning into a rush.
